suite.name: Accessibility - WCAG Audit
suite.description: Demonstrates assert_a11y (axe-core WCAG audit). landmark-one-main/region are disabled because they flag missing <main>/ARIA-region structure on a single static paragraph page with no navigation - a real best-practice note but not a genuine barrier here; every other WCAG 2.1 A/AA rule must still report zero violations.
